goal: Adds a wallet-only -maxfeerate startup option so wallets stop conflating a total-fee cap (-maxtxfee) with a fee-rate cap.
Prevents the wallet from creating or broadcasting a transaction whose fee rate exceeds the configured limit, fixing a longstanding ambiguity reported in #29220.

result.summary: This PR adds a new wallet-only `-maxfeerate` startup option that caps the fee rate (sat/vB) the wallet will use when creating or broadcasting a transaction, separate from the existing absolute `-maxtxfee` cap. It threads the new limit through wallet transaction creation, fee bumping, sendall, and BroadcastTransaction, adds a distinct `MAX_FEE_RATE_EXCEEDED` error, and updates numerous functional and unit tests plus release notes. The PR has been open since January 2024, went through many rounds of approach and implementation review, and settled on the current design after early pushback on making it node-wide rather than wallet-specific.
result.problem: Users could not reliably guard against paying an accidentally excessive fee rate: `-maxtxfee` caps total absolute fee, but for small transactions a fee-rate typo (e.g. sat/vB entered as if it were a total fee) could slip past that cap, as reported in issue #29220. Wallet users and downstream tooling that construct transactions with explicit fee rates feel this gap most.

resolved_concerns: Early approach disagreement (glozow, luke-jr) over making this node-wide vs wallet-only was resolved by making it a wallet-only option.

josibake's concern about combining -maxtxfee and -maxfeerate causing confusing coin-selection interactions was resolved via discussion (achow101, murchandamus) establishing legitimate independent use cases.
A subtle vsize-mismatch bug causing test flakiness was root-caused and fixed by the author (documented in a lengthy comment on 2026-02-13).

polespinasa's sendall bump-fee accounting bug (creation-time check ignoring bump fees while broadcast-time check includes them) was fixed by the author and covered by a new test, with a re-ACK following.

result.card: This PR adds a wallet-only -maxfeerate startup option and enforces it across transaction creation, fee bumping, sendall, and broadcast, fixing the ambiguity where -maxtxfee was used both as an absolute-fee and a feerate sanity check (issue #29220). It has been open since January 2024 with extensive review from achow101, josibake, murchandamus, furszy, and polespinasa, including two late-discovered accounting bugs (a vsize mismatch causing test flakiness, and a sendall bump-fee gap flagged by polespinasa) that the author fixed and got re-ACKed on. The strongest evidence of importance is achow101 and murchandamus independently confirming a legitimate combined -maxtxfee/-maxfeerate use case, and the direct link to a filed user complaint. Reviewability is Ready: polespinasa ACKed the exact head commit after the last fix. No PR dependency; it does introduce new RPC-visible error text that changes existing sendrawtransaction/testmempoolaccept error behavior, a narrower compatibility consideration flagged early by glozow.
